issues.problem: pt-passive explain gave に as the only doer marker; makers/authors of created things take によって.
issues.action: Added the によって rule with an example.

issues.problem: pt-passive potential contrast said the object of the potential takes が; を is also normal.
issues.action: Reworded: doer with に = passive; object with が or を and no doer = potential.

issues.problem: pt-causative example English had a dangling modifier ('As a child, my mother made me...').
issues.action: Changed to 'When I was a child, my mother made me...'.

issues.problem: pt-sasete explain called させてくれる 'told from the allower's side'; くれる keeps the receiver's viewpoint, with the allower as grammatical subject.
issues.action: Reworded to 'With the allower as subject'.

issues.problem: pt-zuni explain and contrast claimed ずに can never express a cause; written style uses ず (and sometimes ずに) for causes, e.g. 分からず、困った.
issues.action: Restated: for a cause use なくて; written style uses ず alone. Contrast note rewritten accordingly.

issues.problem: pt-zuni examples: 'and I was stuck' hid the causal link; 'My homework wouldn't get finished' was awkward English.
issues.action: Changed to 'so I was stuck' and 'I couldn't finish my homework, so I stayed up late last night.'
